page.overview:
What is Mortal Kombat: Special Forces?

Mortal Kombat: Special Forces is an action game for the PlayStation. It allows the player to take on the role of Jax Briggs as he and his base operative, Gemini, attempt to track down the Black Dragon and bring them to justice.

The game takes place some time before the original Mortal Kombat, but how long exactly is unknown.

The story of the game involves Kano freeing his gang, the Black Dragon (No Face, Tasia, Jarek, and Tremor) from a maximum security prison and Jax, seeking revenge for the slaughter of his Special Forces comrades at the hands of the Black Dragon, undertakes a mission to stop them from retrieving an artifact of great power, the Eye of Chitian. The true power of the artifact is shown in the ending that it can open portals to other realms when Jax uses the artifact to teleport himself and Kano back to Earthrealm after defeating him.
